audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 4-5 in the full layer read as 'the lane-control window: trade around Twilight Shroud's cooldown and bank small leads', while the content layer calls the same stage 'your weakest window'. The two layers described opposite lanes.
audit.why: At 4-5 Ambessa's Q is 14-11s and her E is 13-10s — her longest cooldowns — while Shuriken Flip is already down to 13-11.5s and Twilight Shroud to 18-17s. She cannot hold Akali still long enough to cash a trade. The content layer is right; the full layer was boilerplate.
audit.corrected: phases[3].why now states the cooldown mismatch and tells you to farm to 6 rather than force.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Level 6 line was the generic 'the R lock isolates and finishes the chain — point it at the kill, not the tank'. It never said what Akali's own 6 does to that lock.
audit.why: Perfect Execution is a leap that re-casts into a second dash. Public Execution suppresses on arrival and then stuns — once the stun ends she is free, so the second cast of her R takes her straight out of the window Ambessa just spent 130 seconds on. That is the whole reason her 6 beats hers.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why now names Perfect Execution's 120s cooldown and the recast that escapes the stun.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 2's 'why' claimed 'dash-resets stack your passive shield mid-trade', and every cooldown reference in the full layer was wordless ('matchup-defining', 'your committal tool').
audit.why: Drakehound's Step gives bonus attack range, damage, attack speed and an energy refund — no shield anywhere in it; Repudiation is her only shield. Riot's Twilight Shroud text is 'unable to be selected by enemy spells and attacks', so a combo thrown into it hits literally nothing, and it is 20s at rank 1 falling to 16s. Shuriken Flip is 16s to 10s and is both her poke and her escape.
audit.corrected: phases[1].why, breakdown.cooldowns, report[5].t, dosFull[0].d and dontsFull[0].d now carry the real numbers and the real unselectable wording.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three Don't descriptions did not match their own titles: 'Fight her 6 with no MR' was explained as 'burning it for tiny value', and 'Get Q-poked down' was explained as 'dumping every dash going IN'.
audit.why: The titles are the right mistakes. Her 6 is a 120s AP burst, which is what MR answers; Five Point Strike is a 1.5s cooldown but costs 110 energy at rank 1, so walking her out of poke range drains her rather than you.
audit.corrected: dontsFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d rewritten to explain their own titles with the real numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer calls Akali 'he' in four separate places — 'weave the second dash through his answer', 'if he snowballs', 'make him flinch first', 'shoved to his tower'.
audit.why: It reads as copied boilerplate from another matchup and undermines trust in the rest of the page.
audit.corrected: Fixed in the strings I was already rewriting (dosFull[1].d, breakdown.feeding). The remaining copies live in tradeGood, tradeBad, breakdown.trading, breakdown.wave and report[3]/[4]/[9]/[12], which are duplicate renderings of the same two boilerplate sentences.

edits.before: Empowered-hit weaving wins the early AA exchanges. Identify how Akali contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Twilight Shroud is locked until 2, so she cannot vanish — Q-cone and empowered-auto her every time she steps to a melee minion.

edits.before: Dash-resets stack your passive shield mid-trade. Only take the trade when Akali's Twilight Shroud is down.
edits.after: Shroud lands at 2 on a 20s cooldown — she can erase exactly one commit, so make her spend it on nothing.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Twilight Shroud's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Your longest Q and E cooldowns land here while Shuriken Flip is already 13s and kites both — give the trade up and farm to 6.

edits.before: The R lock isolates and finishes the chain — point it at the kill, not the tank. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Akali's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Perfect Execution is 120s and re-casts: your suppress holds her only until the stun ends, so she dashes straight out of it. Do not spend R expecting a free kill.

edits.before: - Akali Twilight Shroud: matchup-defining — Untargetable inside. Combo when down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Twilight Shroud: 20s rank 1, 16s rank 5 — unselectable by spells and attacks inside it, so never combo into it. - Shuriken Flip: 16s to 10s, her poke and her escape. - Perfect Execution: 120s, and it re-casts out of your stun.

edits.before: Untargetable inside. Combo when down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Unselectable inside it, 20s at rank 1 — engage only once she has spent it.

edits.before: Cast-dash-empowered-hit on Akali's step-up, weave the second dash through his answer, and exit with shield banked.
edits.after: Q-cone her on the step-up, dash out on Drakehound's Step, and land the empowered auto before Shuriken Flip is back.

edits.before: That is Akali's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Shroud makes her unselectable by spells and attacks — your whole combo hits nothing.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Perfect Execution is 120s of AP burst — Mercury's Treads before her 6.

edits.before: Dumping every dash going IN — Ambessa with no dash left is a duelist who forgot the door.
edits.after: Five Point Strike is 1.5s but costs 110 energy at rank 1 — walk out of range and it drains her.

edits.before: Track Akali's Twilight Shroud: Untargetable inside. Combo when down. When it is down — Dash-combo + R her.
edits.after: Twilight Shroud: 20s at rank 1, unselectable inside — commit only once she has spent it or Shuriken Flip.

edits.before: If Akali gets a kill, stop forcing and respect Twilight Shroud. Two kills: farm safe and call for jungle cover. If he snowballs, play for picks with your team — not solo redemption.
edits.after: If Akali gets a kill, stop forcing and respect Twilight Shroud. Two kills: farm safe and call for jungle cover. If she snowballs, play for picks with your team — not solo redemption.

notes: Akali is called 'he' throughout the templated half of the full layer; I fixed the two strings I rewrote and listed the rest in the point-13 audit entry rather than burning edits on pure boilerplate duplicates. CHART CONFLICT not fixable under the length rule: content whys[0] says Level 1 is unambiguously Ambessa's because Twilight Shroud is locked, but win[0] and phases[0].side both say 'Skill' — swapping 'Skill' for 'Ambessa' is 5 characters against 7 and fails the +/-10% band, so I left the side and made the 'why' state the real reason. Ambessa's kit file flags grounding on Repudiation and grounding plus heal on Public Execution; Riot's descriptions contain none of that, so I never claimed W or R grounds or heals. Whether her suppression is stopped by tenacity, Cleanse or QSS is not in the data and I made no claim.
